source.label: 2024 Universal Registration Document, consolidated cash flow statement (total tax paid)
2024 Universal Registration Document, management report section 5.2 Research and development costs

notes: Taxes: the consolidated cash flow statement's own 'TOTAL TAX PAID' (EUR 5,790m) = tax paid in operating activities (EUR 5,531m) + tax paid related to interim and final dividends paid (EUR 259m, withholding on intra-group dividends, in financing activities) + tax on investment disposals (nil). Operating-only figure would be 5.53. R&D: LVMH reports no R&D line in the income statement; the management report gives 'research and development investments' of EUR 205m (mainly Perfumes & Cosmetics scientific research); the accounting policy states research expenditure is not capitalized, so it is treated as expensed. Rounded from 0.205.
